reason: Per-query overhead on the serverless 2X-Small warehouse dominates TPC-H at these scales. Per-query means are flat across scale (geometric mean 953 ms at SF 0.1, 999 ms at SF 1, 1294 ms at SF 10, x1.37 over a 100x increase in LINEITEM). The result cache is verified off (cache_control validated, cache_disabled true) and measurement runs at 0.83 to 0.85 of warmup, so cached results do not explain the flat timings.
